purpose: Audit the pinned official retained input set (base + .day + gbbq) and produce an explicit CompatibilityEvidence artifact for file_consistency::validate. The audit records only mechanical facts; the Final Gate decides whether they suffice to retire FILE_SET_CONSISTENCY_NOT_VERIFIED.

preview_database.note: read-only observation; day-version snapshot_inputs bindings are immutable once committed, so observed facts are stable under append-only writes

checks: each retained file byte-rehashed and equal to its manifest sha256 (byte integrity re-verified, not trusted)
every published day data_version binds snapshot_inputs for exactly the manifest day + gbbq archive sha256s (sole-input coverage, zero violations)
every effective day head is backed by a version published from this set (no combination failure observed in the exercised domain)
catalog version exists with acquired_at == base acquisition_completed_at and source == official-file:<manifest_sha256[:16]> (base exercised via catalog publication)
aggregate exercised event counts parsed from adjustment_evidence (statistics, not a gate)

evidence_artifact.member_bindings: all three required roles bound to manifest sha256; source_revision and source_identity absent (no file carries those annotations, so none are asserted)
evidence_artifact.valid_window: closed interval [min acquisition_started_at, max acquisition_completed_at] over the three manifest entries

scope_limits: This evidence asserts that the exact pinned file set was exercised together across the full published domain with verified outcomes. It does not assert vendor authorization (that remains #71, FILE_ACCESS_USE_NOT_VERIFIED).
Compatibility here means composability of this pinned set for this snapshot generation. A future download generation requires a new manifest and a new audit.
The audit does not decode GBBQ records itself; applied/excluded event counts are read verbatim from the stored adjustment_evidence produced by official_market.
